title: Insurance Requirements For Homeless Service Providers / Fiscal Impacts of Insurance Costs / City Policies Impacting Insurance Costs
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the City Administrative Officer, Chief Legislative Analyst, and Los Angeles Housing Department to report on insurance requirements for homeless service providers, including a review of City actions that may impact the ability of service providers to effectively provide support to the City, fiscal impacts of insurance costs and City policies impacting costs, and other relevant policies, legislation, or actions that involve insurance impacts on the homeless service sector. PRESENTED BY VookzA YSABELJURADO— Councilmember, 14th District SECONDED BY Ml/ SEP 0 8 2025

requests.asks: Insurance requirements for homeless service providers, the fiscal impacts of insurance costs, and City policies that affect those costs.
